claims: The 2026 Chicago River dyeing took place on Saturday, March 14, 2026.
The 2026 Chicago River dyeing took place at 10 a.m. CT.
The 2026 Chicago River dyeing was organized by the Chicago Journeymen Plumbers Local 130.
The Chicago River dyeing is a 64-year tradition.
The 64-year tradition uses ~40 lbs of a secret, environmentally friendly, vegetable-based dye.
The dye turns the river a bright emerald green.
The powdered dye itself is actually orange-red.
This information reflects the most recent event on March 14, 2026.
